description: NaNbO₃ is Orthorhombic Perovskite-like structured and crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pca2₁ space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.40-2.81 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.69 Å. There are two inequivalent Nb sites. In the first Nb site, Nb is bonded to six O atoms to form corner-sharing NbO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 25-29°. There are a spread of Nb-O bond distances ranging from 1.91-2.14 Å. In the second Nb site, Nb is bonded to six O atoms to form corner-sharing NbO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 18-33°. There are a spread of Nb-O bond distances ranging from 1.92-2.11 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and two Nb atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and two equivalent Nb atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na and two Nb atoms to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₂Nb₂ tetrahedra. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na and two equivalent Nb atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na and two equivalent Nb atoms. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na and two equivalent Nb atoms.
